learning.title: Tooth decay
learning.text: Decay is one possible cause of toothache. A dentist needs to examine the tooth to establish the cause.

learning.title: Tooth sensitivity
learning.text: Dentin beneath enamel surrounds the pulp. When dentin is exposed, temperature changes can stimulate the tissues inside.

learning.title: Damaged teeth or fillings
learning.text: A damaged tooth or filling can be associated with pain. Record the affected area and arrange a dental examination.

learning.title: Dental abscess
learning.text: An infection-related collection in teeth or gums needs urgent dental treatment. The symptom form cannot confirm or exclude an abscess.

learning.title: A rubbing bracket or wire
learning.text: Record the location and contact the orthodontic team. Orthodontic wax can cover a rubbing area while you arrange advice.

learning.title: Brackets, wires and ligatures
learning.text: Fixed braces attach brackets to teeth. Small elastic ligatures retain the archwire in conventional brackets.

datasets.title: Serial 3D Dental Models
datasets.institution: Amir Abdi & Mahtab Nouri · Mendeley Data
datasets.access: Two original reference STL casts bundled; full series publicly downloadable.
datasets.limitation: Normal occlusions without orthodontic treatment. No per-tooth segmentation or treatment response labels.

datasets.title: Aariz Cephalometric Dataset
datasets.institution: Islamic International Dental College / Riphah International University
datasets.access: One original validation JPEG and its senior expert annotation bundled. Full ZIP is about 2.1 GB.
datasets.limitation: Reference only; no trained detector or diagnostic model. Article license differs from dataset license.

datasets.title: Orthodont growth measurements
datasets.institution: UNC Dental School · Potthoff & Roy / R nlme
datasets.access: Original R-universe CSV bundled with package license and provenance.
datasets.limitation: Historical craniofacial distances, not tooth movement, brace outcomes or reference thresholds.

datasets.title: Teeth3DS+
datasets.institution: Digital Research Center of Sfax · Udini · Inria
datasets.license: Check the selected OSF data release terms
datasets.access: Official release and download instructions linked; not bundled.
datasets.limitation: Website CC BY-SA is not assumed to license every dataset file. Preserve the official patient-level split.

datasets.title: Bite2Text
datasets.institution: University of Modena and Reggio Emilia · University of Ferrara
datasets.access: Official access route linked; sign-in required. No account created or restricted files fetched.
datasets.limitation: Clinician reports and photographs need the dataset’s access agreement. Hidden test cases are not training data.
